nodes.name: Weekday - 07:00
nodes.notes: Set to weekdays only in the node UI, or gate with an IF on the weekday.

nodes.name: Calendar - today's meetings
nodes.notes: Google Calendar shown. No Google? Swap for Microsoft Outlook Calendar, or an HTTP request to your calendar API.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: SELECT Id, Name, Account.Name, StageName, Amount, CloseDate, ForecastCategoryName FROM Opportunity WHERE Account.Website LIKE '%<<attendee domain>>%' AND IsClosed = false ORDER BY CloseDate ASC

nodes.name: Salesforce - match account/opportunity
nodes.notes: Map the attendee email domains from the calendar node into the query. Prefer open opportunities; fall back to the most recent closed.

nodes.name: Recorder - prior conversations
nodes.notes: Join calls to the matched accounts/opportunities; take the most recent 3-5 summaries each. No Gong? Swap for your recorder's API, or ingest exports via the dealtrace adapters.
